# PR #1745: Patch: daily super run failed

Closes #1728

## What changed

Super run 39954622208 failed in three jobs. Each fix below is the change that makes that job pass.

| Job | Root cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| **fuzz (1/4)**, seed 553, I4 | An engine bug. Animating a Unit that stands in its backrow zone (a Flying Unit, R1081000) moved it into the unit row in Attack Position, readied it and re-stamped `summonedTurn`. In seed 553 this was M #47 Taotie with C+ #74 Twice Forward One Step Backwards fused into it, moved on p2's turn by that trap's animate step. | `animated.rs` `step_into_units`: a card that `stands_in_backrow` is already a Unit, as an animated card is. It stays where it is and nothing changes. This is the new ruling **R1728000**, with its note, a clause in the §6.1 Animated row and a paragraph in `spec/11-rulings.md`. |
| **fuzz (2/4)**, seed 2870, I8 | A bug in the I8 monitor. While a Mayor acts, `legal_actions` lists an activation that has no pick left with `targets: None` (R1200, `without_target_picks`). I8's forged copy expected an empty list instead. | `testkit/invariants.rs` `forged_activations`: in that one case (a Mayor acting, an empty pick list), the copy I8 expects to find listed is written with no targets. The forged bodies themselves still carry the empty list. |
| **web (audio, fx, asset and daily tests)** | The R293 sweep "the autopilot wins most other deals" won 5 of 10 deals and needs 6. It is deterministic, not a flake: the planner traced it to #1713, the AI's switch to Defense Position. | Lesson 4's `aiDeck` now has `core-003` Right-house defender where `core-015` Me and Mr Token was, in the same position, so the deal order stays the same. |

Tests added:
- three `r1728000_*` tests in `crates/engine/tests/rules/ranged_flying.rs`: `animate_card`, the `animate` verb, and `animate_at_turn_start`;
- two `r1200_i8_*` tests in `crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs`. The second shows that I8 still fires when the list leaves the activation out;
- corpus records `seed-553-v0.4.4b.json` and `seed-2870-v0.4.4b.json`.

## How it was checked

The previous run stopped at its usage limit. In this run `main` (658df0331) was merged in, and the conflicts in `spec/11-rulings.md` and `spec/INDEX.md` were resolved by keeping both sides (R1723000, then R1728000). The index was regenerated and came out unchanged. Everything below was run on the merged tree:

- **Formatting and lint:** `cargo fmt --check` passed, and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` exited 0.
- **Full test suite:** `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` gave 13,812 passed, 0 failed and 11 ignored (the daily tests), exit 0, with no diff in `apps/web/src/wire/`.
- **Repository checks:** `spec check` printed "1111 rulings … ok"; `catalog check` and `patches check` passed.
- **The two failing seeds:**
  - `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 553 --seeds 1` and `--from 2870 --seeds 1` each printed "1 passed, 0 failed".
  - A binary built from `main` still fails both seeds with the issue's I4 and I8 messages.
  - `cargo jackioh fuzz --regress` printed "10 record(s) passed or retired, 0 problem(s)".
- **The daily fuzz shards at full size:**
  - plain seeds 1–10,000: 10,000 passed, 0 violations;
  - `--handicap` 1–10,000: 10,000 passed;
  - `--duos` 1–2,000: 0 failed.
  - `fuzz --seeds 200` (the pull-request gate) passed 200.
- **The web's daily sweep:** after `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`, `JACKIOH_DAILY=1 vitest run --project web src/tutorial/scripts/advanced.test.ts` passed 8 of 8. With the swap undone on the merged tree, it still fails with "loss win loss win loss win loss win loss win: expected 5 to be greater than or equal to 6". `main`'s autopilot changes (R1714000) did not change that.
- **Other web checks:**
  - the harness's `vitest run --project web --changed origin/main …` passed 904 in 47 files, with 1 skipped (a test gated to the daily run);
  - `src/tutorial/lessons.test.ts` passed 8 of 8;
  - eslint on `advanced.ts` was clean.
- **Classify:** it was run on a temporary merge commit, with a base binary built from `origin/main` in its own target directory. `classify --base origin/main --parent-bin … --claims --json` gave `{"kind":"app","tier":null,"cards":[],"rule":false,"stage2":"ran","problems":[]}`, so no patch fragment is needed. The temporary worktrees are removed.

A pull request's CI plays only 200 fuzz seeds and leaves out the daily sweep. The next super run (`gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>`) is what confirms all three jobs.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Seed 553: I fixed the engine, not the monitor.** Counting the move as an entry would have quieted I4. I rejected that because it moves a Flying Unit out of the zone its controller chose and readies a spent attacker, against R1081000 ("a Unit for every rule") and §6.1 ("one already a Unit … stays where it is").
- **Tutorial: I swapped one card in the AI deck,** following 23652cb6e and #898. I rejected:
  - lowering `ALT_WINS_MIN`, which weakens the 60% the sweep has held;
  - swapping cards in the human deck, which an earlier planning run measured at 5–6 wins of 10;
  - a tutorial-only AI setting, because §9.10 says the tutorial AI's search is every tier's.
- **The record names the cards (a departure from the plan).** The record's `found`, R1728000's note and the rulings paragraph name C+ #74 Twice Forward One Step Backwards instead of the plan's "an Animated card", because the previous run traced seed 553 to it.

## Worth a second look

- `stands_in_backrow` only matches a standing Unit: one with a position whose type is Unit. A Field Spell, a Trap or a set Cloaked Unit (which reads as a Trap) still animates, and the existing `animated.rs` and `effects_animate.rs` rules tests pass.
- This changes engine behaviour, but no catalog entry or script changed, so no replay version gate was added (R767000). The golden replay passes in the cargo tests, and classify's stage 2 found no divergence.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 1 of 10.

Notes the reviewer left (not blocking):

- `crates/engine/src/animated.rs:154`: This changes how games play: a Flying Unit standing in the backrow that something animates (M #47 Taotie with C+ #74 fused in, or one granted Animated on your turn) now stays put. No patch fragment claims it and no replay version gate was added.
